name: button-group
description: A bordered container that visually groups related ghost buttons into a connected control.

accessibility.individualButtons: Each button needs its own accessible label.
accessibility.keyboard: Standard tab order through each button.

constraints: Do not mix text and icon buttons in one group.
No group-level disabled state; disable individual buttons.

useCases: Formatting controls where options are complementary but independent (Bold / Italic / Underline in a rich text editor)
View-mode toggles where the user picks one display mode at a time (List view / Grid view / Table view)
Zoom and transform controls in a canvas or map toolbar (Zoom in / Zoom out)
Alignment controls in a design or layout tool (Align left / Align center / Align right)
Export or share actions that are closely related but individually invokable (Export / Preview / Share)

3.whenToUse: Three equally weighted actions in the same cluster

Horizontal.whenToUse: Text-label actions where the labels communicate the distinction
examples: Month / Week / Day in a calendar

Vertical.whenToUse: Icon-only stacked controls where vertical real estate is better than horizontal
examples: Zoom in / Zoom out on a map
Align top / center / bottom in a layout panel

comparedTo.notInstead: button-group (grouping a lone button adds visual noise with no meaning)

comparedTo.situation: Mutually exclusive selection where one option must always be active (like tabs)

comparedTo.notInstead: button-group with 4+ items (too wide and visually cluttered)
button-group (button-group is for actions, not route navigation)

notes: shadcnBase is approximate; this is a custom grouped-button pattern, not shadcn ToggleGroup behavior.

darkMode.notes: No known dark mode differences — all tokens are semantic and mode-aware.
